name: ci4-website-builder-web
description: Public website frontend powered by ci4-website-builder-domain

scripts.build:js: esbuild src/js/site.js --bundle --outfile=public/assets/js/site.js --format=iife --banner:js="/* Generated from src/js — do not edit directly. Run: npm run build:js */" --minify
scripts.dev:js: esbuild src/js/site.js --bundle --outfile=public/assets/js/site.js --format=iife --banner:js="/* Generated from src/js — do not edit directly. Run: npm run build:js */" --watch
scripts.build:all: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
